title: Local data on a larger ball: room, bounds, measurability and integrability (parent Steps 1–6)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Euclidean, with its Borel σ-algebra). Let V be a rectifiable n-varifold in E with weight μ := V.weight such that μ is finite on compact sets (IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ) and the map x ↦ p_x := (T_xV).starProjection (a continuous linear map E → E) is μ-a.e. strongly measurable. Let U ⊆ E be open, H : E → E locally μ-integrable on U (LocallyIntegrableOn H U μ), h : E → ℝ with h ∈ C¹(U) (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U), ξ ∈ E and ρ > 0 with tsupport h ∩ B_ρ(ξ) ⊆ U, where B_s(ξ) := closedBall ξ s is the closed ball. Write q := V.normalRadialSq ξ, i.e. q(x) = |p_{(T_xV)^⊥}(x − ξ)|²/|x − ξ|² (Lean convention a/0 = 0), and ∇^M h := V.tangentialGradient h, i.e. ∇^M h(x) = p_x(∇h(x)) with ∇h := gradient h. Then there exist real numbers R and A such that: (a) ρ < R; (b) tsupport h ∩ B_R(ξ) ⊆ U; (c) h and q are a.e. strongly measurable with respect to μ restricted to B_R(ξ); (d) |h(x)| ≤ A and |q(x)| ≤ 1 for every x ∈ B_R(ξ); (e) x ↦ ⟨x − ξ, ∇^M h(x)⟩ is μ-integrable on B_R(ξ); (f) G(x) := ⟨x − ξ, ∇^M h(x) + h(x)H(x)⟩ is μ-integrable on B_R(ξ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (ρ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight → IsOpen U → LocallyIntegrableOn H U V.weight → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U → tsupport h ∩ closedBall ξ ρ ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → ∃ R A : ℝ, ρ < R ∧ tsupport h ∩ closedBall ξ R ⊆ U ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable h (V.weight.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (V.normalRadialSq ξ) (V.weight.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |h x| ≤ A ∧ |V.normalRadialSq ξ x| ≤ 1) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ inner ℝ (x - ξ) (V.tangentialGradient h x)) (closedBall ξ R) V.weight ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ inner ℝ (x - ξ) (V.tangentialGradient h x + h x • H x)) (closedBall ξ R) V.weight
